Priya_CS: Sandstone pilot in SG next Monday. They need a region-bound header allow rule + short-term QPS uplift for demo traffic. Also called out renewal pricing as a risk during onboarding call.
Hannah (Sandstone): Confirmed. Demo window 2026-04-06 11:00-17:00 SGT. We can send header X-SD-Tenant: sandstone-demo and our egress CIDR 198.51.100.192/29. Target: baseline 40 qps, burst to 180 qps for 4h. Please auto-revoke after window.
Marcus_SE: We can do region-bound rules on apac-proxy and a burst profile. Recommend soft_limit=180 with a 4h duration and a 30m ramp. Will also prepare a quick cost delta for the renewal packet.
Priya_CS: Tenant id: SND-110. Preferred apply window 10:40-10:50 SGT on demo day for a staged rollout. @Yun_Networks can you stage the manifest and set logs retention to 14d (they asked for two weeks)?
Yun_Networks: Staging now. Planned manifest: ```
allow_rule:
  tenant: SND-110
  region: apac-sg
  match:
    headers:
      X-SD-Tenant: "sandstone-demo"
    cidrs: ["198.51.100.192/29"]
traffic:
  baseline_qps: 40
  burst_qps: 180
  ramp: 30m
  duration: 4h
  expire_at: 2026-04-06T17:30:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 14
  redact_payloads: true
notes: "demo - auto-revoke; renewal follow-up SND-110"
```
config-bot: Change staged by Yun_Networks on apac-proxy-3. Staging ID: stg-z9e2. Scheduled apply: 2026-04-06T10:45:00+08:00.
Yun_Networks: Applied stg-z9e2 -> live 2026-04-06T10:47:00+08:00. Region-bound header+CIDR rule active. Burst profile enabled. Alerts: 5xx > 0.35% OR p95 token-latency > 300ms.
Hannah (Sandstone): Smoke looks good. Pre-demo load shows 2xx and latency ~180ms. We will start pushing traffic at 11:05.
Marcus_SE: I'll capture a perf snapshot at T+90m and produce token-level latency + cost/1k tokens for the CRM renewal note. Priya, can you schedule a 30-min renewal touch 3 days after demo?
Priya_CS: Scheduling now for 2026-04-09 15:00 SGT. Marking as renewal-risk in CRM SND-110; will attach Marcus's perf+cost doc.
Hannah (Sandstone): One more request: can you limit retained logs to headers+meta only (no payload) and grant our security team view access for 7d?
Yun_Networks: Confirmed: payload redaction on, headers+status+latency retained. Creating a secure viewer token valid for 7d scoped to SND-110.
Marcus_SE: Posting interim numbers: 90m in hold - p95=210ms, error rate 0.1%, token count ~12.1M. Estimated incremental cost for burst window: ~$420 (token compute + infra delta). Will upload full breakdown to CRM.
Priya_CS: Thanks Marcus. I'll include the cost as part of renewal options (pilot credit or 1-month committed discount). Hannah, any initial feedback from your side?
Hannah (Sandstone): Positive so far. Team asked about predictable pricing if we keep this pattern. Please include options in the renewal packet.
Yun_Networks: Auto-revoke confirmed for 2026-04-06T17:30+08:00. If any 5xx spikes or latency regressions, I'll page oncall.
config-bot: Audit note: stg-z9e2 -> live recorded by Yun_Networks at 2026-04-06T10:47:00+08:00.
Priya_CS: Closing loop: recorded in account health, renewal follow-up scheduled, and perf+cost doc to be attached. If anything degrades, page oncall. Thanks team!
